I moved the "Comment Updated" success notification out of the component and into the mutation hook. Tests, lint and the app were not run, as you asked.

- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/api/update-comment.ts`**: `useUpdateComment` now calls `useNotifications()` and shows the success notification in `onSuccess`, after the query invalidation and before the caller's `onSuccess`.
- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx`**: removed the `useNotifications` import and call. `useUpdateComment` is now called with just `discussionId`, so the component no longer passes a `mutationConfig`.

Nothing is committed. The other uses of `useNotifications` in `delete-comment.tsx`, `create-comment.tsx` and the discussion and user components are outside this change, so I left them alone.
